community.note: Current projects come from the public Hatchery queue; receipt history is a bounded public window. Earliest returned receipt is not necessarily discovery time. Heat measures recent community attention; fidelity measures agreement and qualified participation. Neither is quality, safety or investment verification.

gaps: Based.bid exact chain, token, quote and pool identity is unavailable or mismatched.
No verified exact AXO V4 pool market is available from Based.bid or DEXScreener. Price, volume and momentum remain unknown.
Market history is an official hourly snapshot series, not live OHLCV; gaps and stale observations remain visible.
No current holder count is inferred from reward eligibility or historical records. Raw pool custody is not locked supply.
Epoch allocations and prepared/unsigned awards are not paid rewards. Generic ERC20 denominations lack exact reward identity and are never summed as AXO.
Public participant and pet counts are source-defined ledger records, not unique humans. No private linked-account data is requested.
The site’s older descriptive pages can disagree with current APIs; dated public endpoint states take precedence and remain attributed.
